crossRefs.note: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

parallels.note: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

people.name: Amram
people.line: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam

people.name: Hebron
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Izhar
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi; father of Korah.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Uzziel
people.line: Son of Kohath, uncle of Moses and Aaron

translations.web: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
translations.bsb: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
translations.kjv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
translations.asv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
